qt: to the Commission Clare Daly (The Left) Subject:
Can the Commission indicate the total cost of using chartered private aircraft or private air taxi services for its official business in the years 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2023?
at: (English version) to the Commission Clare Daly (The Left) (23 April 2024) Subject: Cost of chartered private aircraft or private air taxi services Can the Commission indicate the total cost of using chartered private aircraft or private air taxi services for its official business in the years 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2023? (10 March 2025) The total cost of using chartered air taxi services for its official business in the years 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2023 was respectively EUR 785 412, EUR 2 052 211, EUR 1 789 877 and EUR 1 296 739.
